samples.summary: New Remove-link toolbar button has no test at all (renders only under `showRemoveLink`, wiring to `editor.removeLink`)
samples.evidence: The diff adds a whole new user-facing control: `showRemoveLink` prop, `handleRemoveLink` (calls `editor.removeLink?.()` then `editor.focus()`), the `IconUnlink` ToolbarButton with `aria-label="Remove link"`, plus opt-ins in `text-edit-section.tsx` and `mobile-toolbar.tsx`. Per the diff's own reasoning this is *the only* way to drop an href in Slides. No test exercises it: `packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts` renders `TextFormatGroup` with a JSX-less React harness and queries by `aria-label`, so such a test is trivially expressible, yet it (and `toolbar-focus.test.ts`, `color-reset.test.ts`) never mentions `showRemoveLink`/"Remove link"; `tests/app/slides/toolbar/text-edit-section.test.ts` only smoke-imports the module and asserts state shape; `mobile-text-toggles.test.ts` merely stubs `removeLink: vi.fn()` on the mock editor without asserting the button exists or is clicked. Because `removeLink` is optional on `TextFormattingEditor` and invoked with `?.()`, a broken/unwired surface silently no-ops with nothing to catch it (frontend has no tsc either). Also untested: that the docs surface keeps the button hidden by default.

samples.summary: Text-box `clearInlineFormatting` collapsed-caret-at-link-trailing-edge case is untested (and lacks the override the docs path got)
samples.evidence: `TextBoxEditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting` still calls `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)` with no trailing-edge `href: undefined` override — the addition the diff made only to `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting` (editor.ts:3366) and `TextEditor.clearFormatting`. The new test file `packages/docs/test/view/text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts` only covers a select-all range clear and `removeLink`; it never places a collapsed caret at a link's trailing edge, clears, and types. The docs counterpart deems exactly that scenario a defect ('the next typed character would silently extend the link') and covers it in link-trailing-edge.test.ts, but the slides/text-box equivalent (`text-box-link-trailing-edge.test.ts` covers only Space/Enter) has no such case, so link extension via the Slides Clear-formatting button ships with no coverage.

samples.summary: Text-box clear-formatting tests assert no preconditions, so they pass vacuously if the synthetic select-all does not take effect
samples.evidence: 'keeps the href while clearing the formatting on the same run' dispatches a Ctrl/Meta+'a' keydown then `api.applyStyle({bold:true,color:'#ff0000'})` and `api.clearInlineFormatting()`, but never asserts the style was actually applied or that a selection exists. If select-all silently failed, `applyStyle` would only arm a pending style and `clearInlineFormatting` would be a documented no-op with no selection — the bold/color `toBeFalsy()` assertions and the `some(i => i.style.href === ...)` assertion would then all hold even if Clear formatting stripped hrefs. The second test ('removeLink still drops the hyperlink') asserts only `every(i => !i.style.href)`, which is trivially true if the href was never inserted. An intermediate assertion (bold true before the clear / getRangeStyleSummary) would make both non-vacuous.

samples.summary: The `prev.href === undefined` re-arm clause in both clear-formatting entry points is never exercised by a test
samples.evidence: Both new `exitsLink` expressions OR in `!!(prev && 'href' in prev && prev.href === undefined)` (text-editor.ts:3441-3443 and editor.ts:3366-3369). Every new test (link-trailing-edge.test.ts 'Cmd+\\ at a link trailing edge…', 'the Clear formatting button at a link trailing edge…') reaches the branch through `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` being true, so the short-circuit makes the second disjunct unreachable in the suite. No test sets up a caret where the trailing-edge test is false but a pending `href: undefined` is already armed, so either the clause is dead or its intended scenario is uncovered — nothing distinguishes the two.

samples.summary: Collapsed-caret Cmd+\ now clears the widened key set (fontSize/fontFamily/color/backgroundColor) but no test asserts the newly cleared keys on the pending path
samples.evidence: The diff's stated fix is that the shortcut's hand-rolled list had drifted (omitted fontSize/fontFamily/color/backgroundColor). Only the *range* path asserts the widening: editor-clear-formatting.test.ts:215 checks `link?.style.color` falsy after the shortcut over a selection. The collapsed-caret path (`pending.set(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, …)`) is only exercised by link-trailing-edge tests, which assert `href` and text content and never that text typed after a collapsed-caret clear lost e.g. color/fontSize inherited from the run behind the caret.

samples.summary: Newly exported model helper `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` has no direct unit test
samples.evidence: `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` is now a public model export used by three call sites, and its lookup changed from `getBlock` (throwing) to `doc.findBlock` with a documented claim about header/footer/table-cell reach. No test imports it (grep for the identifier matches only src files), and `packages/docs/test/model/caret-style-surface.test.ts` does not cover it; its split-run guard and the missing-block path are only exercised indirectly through editor-level Space/Enter tests.

verdict.reason: The Remove-link control is real and user-facing: text-format-group.tsx:72/102/310-325 renders a ToolbarButton (aria-label="Remove link") only when showRemoveLink is true, wired to handleRemoveLink (lines 174-178) which calls the optional editor.removeLink?.() then focus(); slides opts in at text-edit-section.tsx:93 and mobile-toolbar.tsx:580. I found no test anywhere exercising it. Repo-wide grep for `showRemoveLink` (excluding node_modules) matches only src, a design doc, and other reviewers' .agent-review artifacts — zero test files. A case-insensitive grep for remove-link/unlink across all of packages/frontend yields only mock stubs (mobile-text-toggles.test.ts:71, text-edit-section.test.ts:37) and the unrelated Docs link-popover test (docs-link-popover.test.tsx:26). Beyond the reviewer's searches I checked: no e2e/playwright/integration spec dirs exist; the visual harness only stubs removeLink: noop (slides-scenarios.tsx:1680) and its driver scripts (verify-visual-browser.mjs, verify-interaction-browser.mjs) never reference it; the other tests/components/text-formatting/* files have no match. Only model-level removeLink tests exist in packages/docs and packages/slides (e.g. slides text-box-editor.test.ts:740 just asserts typeof === 'function'), which do not cover the button's conditional rendering, default-hidden behavior, or click wiring. Since the harness for such a test already exists (mobile-text-toggles.test.ts:84-122 renders the real toolbar and queries by aria-label) and a broken wiring would silently no-op via `?.()`, the gap can let a user-visible defect on the only link-removal path in Slides ship undetected — major, no counterexample found.

finding.summary: Text-box `clearInlineFormatting` collapsed-caret-at-link-trailing-edge case is untested (and lacks the override the docs path got)
finding.evidence: `TextBoxEditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting` still calls `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)` with no trailing-edge `href: undefined` override — the addition the diff made only to `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting` (editor.ts:3366) and `TextEditor.clearFormatting`. The new test file `packages/docs/test/view/text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts` only covers a select-all range clear and `removeLink`; it never places a collapsed caret at a link's trailing edge, clears, and types. The docs counterpart deems exactly that scenario a defect ('the next typed character would silently extend the link') and covers it in link-trailing-edge.test.ts, but the slides/text-box equivalent (`text-box-link-trailing-edge.test.ts` covers only Space/Enter) has no such case, so link extension via the Slides Clear-formatting button ships with no coverage.

verdict.reason: The absence is real (no test anywhere places a collapsed caret at a link's trailing edge in the text-box path, clears, and types), but the defect it is said to hide cannot occur, so it is not a blocking test-adequacy gap. The text-box `applyStyleImpl` (text-box-editor.ts:819-820) early-returns when there is no selection and never touches `pending` — it has no collapsed-caret branch at all. The docs override was needed only because the docs `applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:1167-1174) DOES write `pending.set({ ...caretStyle, ...style })` at a collapsed caret, re-arming the link's `href`; that is what editor.ts:3344-3373 and text-editor.ts:3426-3451 defend against. On the text-box path the Clear-formatting button (routed via text-format-group.tsx:180-184 -> TextBoxEditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting, text-box-editor.ts:1077-1082) is a pure no-op at a collapsed caret, leaving intact the `href: undefined` that `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` (text-editor.ts:5912-5917, wired for text boxes at text-box-editor.ts:445) arms — so no link extension is attributable to the button, and a hypothetical test would pass identically before and after this diff. The behavior this diff actually changed on the text-box path (a range clear keeps the href) IS covered by text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts:111-124, with removeLink at :126-134, and a collapsed-caret invocation is exercised at text-box-editor.test.ts:43-47. I searched all of packages/**/*test* for clearInlineFormatting/clearFormatting and insertLink; every other reference is a `() => {}`/`vi.fn()` stub, so I am confident about both the absence and its harmlessness.

finding.summary: Collapsed-caret Clear formatting at a link trailing edge is tested only for the keyboard path; the toolbar/EditorAPI path (same scenario) has no test
finding.evidence: The delta fixes `TextEditor.clearFormatting()` (text-editor.ts:3438-3448) so a collapsed caret at a link trailing edge re-arms `href: undefined`, and adds `link-trailing-edge.test.ts:236` covering exactly that via the Mod+\ keydown. The equivalent user action through the toolbar button — `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting()` (editor.ts:3344) → `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)` — takes a different collapsed-caret branch: `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)` (editor.ts:1170), which seeds from the caret style (the run behind the caret, href included) and, since `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` no longer carries `href`, leaves the link's href in the pending style while also discarding any armed `href: undefined`. No test covers that path at a trailing edge: `packages/docs/test/view/editor-clear-formatting.test.ts` only exercises range selections (`selectWholeBlock`) plus `removeLink`, and `link-trailing-edge.test.ts` only drives the keydown. So if the toolbar button silently extends the link on the next typed character, the suite stays green — a user-visible link-content defect on the same behavior this delta claims all three entry points share ('Shares CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE with the toolbar button ... so all three clear exactly the same keys').

verdict.reason: The finding claims the toolbar/EditorAPI collapsed-caret Clear-formatting-at-link-trailing-edge scenario has no test. It does: packages/docs/test/view/link-trailing-edge.test.ts:266-278 ('the Clear formatting button at a link trailing edge also exits the link') calls editor.insertLink(...), then editor.clearInlineFormatting() with a collapsed caret at the trailing edge, then type('x') — deliberately a plain character, not Space/Enter, which the neighbouring Cmd+\ test comment explains would mask the bug — and asserts last(inlines).style.href is falsy and the text is 'https://example.comx'. That assertion fails if the pending style retains the link href. The corresponding production guard exists at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3362-3372, where clearInlineFormatting computes exitsLink via isAtLinkTrailingEdge(doc, cursor.position) or a previously armed pending href: undefined, and passes { ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, href: undefined } into applyStyleImpl (whose collapsed-caret branch at editor.ts:1170 seeds from the caret style, exactly as the finding describes). Removing the override would turn this test red, so it is meaningful, not vacuous. Two over-reach guards for the same entry point also exist (link-trailing-edge.test.ts:280-292 clearing inside link text; :294-308 range clear ending at the trailing edge), and packages/docs/test/view/text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts:115,129 covers the text-box entry point. The finding's factual premise is false against this working tree.
